Latest ShowShark: Version 1.0.BETA4

Download ShowShark


Requires: Wireshark 4.0 or later

Download Wireshark


Version History
Version 1.0
v1.0.BETA4

Date: March 2026

What's New
  • Added example capture.
  • Added DMX table for Art-Net.
What's Fixed
  • Fixed Filter Builder syntax and filter editing.
  • Internal refactoring of code.
Known Issues
  • Editing manufacturer and protocol filters manually may not update correctly in the Filter Builder.
  • Host table is missing filter buttons.
  • SLP rows are not added correctly in packet details.
  • mDNS does not parse hostnames.
  • MAC addresses as source or destination are not handled (for example, layer 2 broadcast).
  • Custom display filter fields show.sacn.universe and show.sacn.dmx are not yet functional.
v1.0.BETA3

Date: March 2026

What's New
  • Added 3 colour filter options.
  • Added function to display DMX values by percent, hex or decimal.
  • Added show.artnet.poll field.
  • Added Art-Net poll flag.
What's Fixed
  • Fixed auto-update of host table.
  • Handles multicast destination addresses correctly.
  • Fixed bug showing multiple devices as IGMP querier.
  • Fixed bug showing non-entertainment devices in the host table.
  • Significantly improved performance.
Known Issues
  • Editing manufacturer and protocol filters manually may not update correctly in the Filter Builder.
  • Host table is missing filter buttons.
  • SLP rows are not added correctly in packet details.
  • mDNS does not parse hostnames.
  • MAC addresses as source or destination are not handled (for example, layer 2 broadcast).
  • Custom display filter fields show.sacn.universe and show.sacn.dmx are not yet functional.
v1.0.BETA2

Date: February 2026

Features
  • Support for sACN (E1.31).
  • Support for Art-Net.
  • Support for IGMP.
  • Support for SLP.
  • Entertainment host discovery and visual host tables.
  • Enhanced protocol details for entertainment-specific information like universe numbers and priorities in the packet list columns.
  • Filter Builder (beta): Build complex Wireshark display filters without memorising syntax using the built-in filter builder.
  • Automatic user configuration profile management.
  • Colour-coded packet display.
Known Issues
  • Editing manufacturer and protocol filters manually may not update correctly in the Filter Builder.
  • Host table dialog does not refresh automatically.
  • Host table is missing a filter button.
  • SLP rows are not added correctly in packet details.
  • mDNS does not parse hostnames.
  • MAC addresses as source or destination are not handled (for example, layer 2 broadcast).
  • Custom display filter fields show.sacn.universe and show.sacn.dmx are not yet functional.
